ledger.description: Infosys revised its full-year revenue growth outlook three times. The completed year lets us compare the final target with a like-for-like actual.
ledger.interpretation: The reported 4.2% growth exceeded the original 1–3% range, but finished 0.3 percentage points below the final 4.5–5% range. The revisions are one evolving annual target, not four independent promises.
ledger.method: Full-year consolidated revenue growth, constant-currency basis, year ended 31 March 2025. Publication dates use the transcript filing cover; the timeline shows the statement dates.

evidence.title: Infosys management press conference and earnings call · Apr 2024
evidence.text: our revenue growth guidance for the FY25 is growth of 1% to 3% in constant currency terms.

evidence.title: Infosys management press conference and earnings call · Jul 2024
evidence.text: we have revised our revenue growth guidance for the full financial year to 3% to 4% growth in constant currency terms.

evidence.title: Infosys management press conference and earnings call · Oct 2024
evidence.text: The new guidance is 3.75% to 4.5% growth in constant currency for the full year.

evidence.title: Infosys management press conference and earnings call · Jan 2025
evidence.text: we are revising our revenue growth guidance to growth of 4.5%-5% in constant currency terms.

actualEvidence.title: Infosys management press conference and earnings call · Apr 2025
actualEvidence.text: 4.2% growth, constant currency terms, 21.1% operating margin

evidence.title: Infosys Q4 FY25 fact sheet · quarterly consolidated INR table
evidence.text: INR crore; IFRS consolidated, three months ended. March 2025 / December 2024 / March 2024: Revenue 40,925 / 41,764 / 37,923; profit before income taxes 9,663 / 9,670 / 10,240; net profit after minority interest 7,033 / 6,806 / 7,969.
